(Japanese: '''ミュウツー！我ハココニ在リ''' ''Mewtwo! I Am Here'') is a {{pkmn|manga}} adaptation of the [[Mewtwo Returns|animated series special of the same name]]. It was released to coincide with the release of [[M22|the twenty-second movie]] and {{ma|Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution|its own manga adaptation}}. It is adapted by [[Machito Gomi]].

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
* {{TRT}}'s [[Team Rocket's mechas|balloon]] doesn't have rockets attached to it for a getaway, unlike in the special.
* Instead of a pair of force-field machines, {{an|Giovanni}} uses the armor from ''[[M01|Mewtwo Strikes Back]]'' to restrain {{OBP|Mewtwo|M01}}.
